full_judgment: 2. The facts, in brief, are that the petitioners filed a suit, being the Other Class Suit No.375 of 2007, in the Fifth Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Chittagong, praying for a decree for partition of the suit-land, with a further prayer for decimation of their title. The petitioners also filed an application for an order of injunction to restrain the defendant Nos.2, 3 and 39-42 from making any construction till disposal of the suit. This petition was resisted oh behalf of the concerned defendants, by filing a written objection. After hearing, the Trial Court, by its order dated 20.04.2008, directed the parties to maintain status quo in the suit-land. On appeal, the learned Additional District Judge, First Court, Chittagong, by his order dated 30.07.2008, reversed the order of the learned Assistant Judge and allowed the appeal. The High Court Division, in Revision, found that there is no specific area of demarcation of the land in which the plaintiffs claimed their right, title and possession.
